body.en: Two-dimensional Cartesian vectors: algebraic operations, collinearity, scalar (dot) products, orthogonality, and vector navigation in relative velocity problems.

label.en: ● Deep Conceptual Intuition — Vectors in Two Dimensions & Relative Motion
label.ar: ● الفهم المفاهيمي العميق — المتجهات في بعدين والسرعة النسبية

body.en: Linear Structure, Inner Products & Geometric Transformations: In \(\mathbb{R}^n\), the dot product \(\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v} = \|\mathbf{u}\|\|\mathbf{v}\|\cos\theta = \sum_{i=1}^n u_i v_i\) encodes orthogonality (\(\mathbf{u}\perp\mathbf{v} \iff \mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v} = 0\)) and orthogonal projection \(\operatorname{proj}_{\mathbf{v}}\mathbf{u} = \dfrac{\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}}{\|\mathbf{v}\|^2}\mathbf{v}\). For a matrix transformation \(A \in \mathbb{R}^{n\times n}\), \(|\det(A)|\) measures the local volume scaling factor, and \(A\) is invertible if and only if \(\det(A) \ne 0\) (equivalently, all eigenvalues \(\lambda_i \ne 0\)).
body.ar: الفضاءات المتجهية والتحويلات الخطية: يقيس الضرب القياسي \(\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}\) الزاوية والتعامد بين المتجهات، بينما يقيس محدد المصفوفة \(|\det(A)|\) معامل تغير المساحة أو الحجم.

label.en: ◆ Why It Works — First-Principles Derivation (Vectors in Two Dimensions & Relative Motion)
label.ar: ◆ لماذا تعمل هذه القاعدة — الاشتقاق الرياضي (المتجهات في بعدين والسرعة النسبية)

body.en:
Why Orthogonal Projection & Eigenvalue Characteristic Equations Work: Decompose \(\mathbf{u} = c\mathbf{v} + \mathbf{w}\) where \(\mathbf{w} \perp \mathbf{v}\). Taking the dot product with \(\mathbf{v}\) uses \(\mathbf{w}\cdot\mathbf{v} = 0\) to isolate \(c\):

\[ \mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v} = c(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{v}) + 0 \implies c = \frac{\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}}{\|\mathbf{v}\|^2} \]

For eigenvalues, \(A\mathbf{v} = \lambda\mathbf{v}\) with \(\mathbf{v} \ne \mathbf{0}\) is equivalent to \((A - \lambda I)\mathbf{v} = \mathbf{0}\). A homogeneous linear system has a non-trivial nullspace vector \(\mathbf{v} \ne \mathbf{0}\) if and only if the matrix \(A - \lambda I\) is singular, yielding the characteristic polynomial \(\det(A - \lambda I) = 0\).
body.ar: برهان صيغة المسقط العمودي والمعادلة المميزة للقيم الذاتية: من شرط التعامد \((\mathbf{u}-c\mathbf{v})\cdot\mathbf{v}=0\) ينتج \(c = \frac{\mathbf{u}\cdot\mathbf{v}}{\|\mathbf{v}\|^2}\). وشرط وجود متجه ذاتي غير صفري \((A-\lambda I)\mathbf{v}=\mathbf{0}\) يكافئ انعدام المحدد \(\det(A-\lambda I)=0\).

body.en:
Given position vectors \( \vec{OA} = 3\mathbf{i} + 4\mathbf{j} \) and \( \vec{OB} = -5\mathbf{i} + 12\mathbf{j} \):
(a) Find the unit vector in the direction of \( \vec{OA} \).
(b) Calculate the angle between \( \vec{OA} \) and \( \vec{OB} \) in degrees to 1 decimal place.

Solution:
(a) \( |\vec{OA}| = \sqrt{3^2 + 4^2} = \sqrt{25} = 5 \).
Unit vector \( \mathbf{\hat{OA}} = \frac{1}{5}(3\mathbf{i} + 4\mathbf{j}) = 0.6\mathbf{i} + 0.8\mathbf{j} \).

(b) \( |\vec{OB}| = \sqrt{(-5)^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{25 + 144} = \sqrt{169} = 13 \).
Dot product \( \vec{OA} \cdot \vec{OB} = (3)(-5) + (4)(12) = -15 + 48 = 33 \).
Using \( \vec{OA} \cdot \vec{OB} = |\vec{OA}||\vec{OB}|\cos\theta \):
\[ 33 = (5)(13)\cos\theta = 65\cos\theta \implies \cos\theta = \frac{33}{65} \approx 0.5077 \]
\[ \theta = \cos^{-1}(0.5077) \approx 59.5^\circ \].
Answer: (a) \( \frac{3}{5}\mathbf{i} + \frac{4}{5}\mathbf{j} \), (b) \( 59.5^\circ \).

label.en: Worked Example B — Vectors in Two Dimensions & Relative Motion (Easy Application)
label.ar: مثال محلول B — المتجهات في بعدين والسرعة النسبية (تطبيق Easy)

body.en:
Problem (Easy): The position vectors of points \( A \) and \( B \) relative to an origin \( O \) are given by \( \vec{OA} = 5\mathbf{i} - 2\mathbf{j} \) and \( \vec{OB} = -\mathbf{i} + 6\mathbf{j} \). Find the magnitude of \( \vec{AB} \).

Step-by-Step Solution: To find the vector \( \vec{AB} \), subtract the position vector of \( A \) from that of \( B \): \[ \vec{AB} = \vec{OB} - \vec{OA} = (-\mathbf{i} + 6\mathbf{j}) - (5\mathbf{i} - 2\mathbf{j}) = (-1 - 5)\mathbf{i} + (6 - (-2))\mathbf{j} = -6\mathbf{i} + 8\mathbf{j} \] Next, calculate the magnitude \( |\vec{AB}| \): \[ |\vec{AB}| = \sqrt{(-6)^2 + 8^2} = \sqrt{36 + 64} = \sqrt{100} = 10 \] Common misconceptions: - Calculating \( |\vec{OA} + \vec{OB}| \) gives \( |4\mathbf{i} + 4\mathbf{j}| = \sqrt{16+16} = 4\sqrt{2} \). - Making a sign error when subtracting the \( \mathbf{j} \)-components, \( 6 - 2 = 4 \), leads to \( |-6\mathbf{i} + 4\mathbf{j}| = \sqrt{36 + 16} = \sqrt{52} = 2\sqrt{13} \). - Adding the absolute values of the components directly, \( |-6| + |8| = 14 \), confuses Euclidean distance with Manhattan distance.
body.ar:
مسألة تطبيقية (Easy): The position vectors of points \( A \) and \( B \) relative to an origin \( O \) are given by \( \vec{OA} = 5\mathbf{i} - 2\mathbf{j} \) and \( \vec{OB} = -\mathbf{i} + 6\mathbf{j} \). Find the magnitude of \( \vec{AB} \).

الحل خطوة بخطوة: To find the vector \( \vec{AB} \), subtract the position vector of \( A \) from that of \( B \): \[ \vec{AB} = \vec{OB} - \vec{OA} = (-\mathbf{i} + 6\mathbf{j}) - (5\mathbf{i} - 2\mathbf{j}) = (-1 - 5)\mathbf{i} + (6 - (-2))\mathbf{j} = -6\mathbf{i} + 8\mathbf{j} \] Next, calculate the magnitude \( |\vec{AB}| \): \[ |\vec{AB}| = \sqrt{(-6)^2 + 8^2} = \sqrt{36 + 64} = \sqrt{100} = 10 \] Common misconceptions: - Calculating \( |\vec{OA} + \vec{OB}| \) gives \( |4\mathbf{i} + 4\mathbf{j}| = \sqrt{16+16} = 4\sqrt{2} \). - Making a sign error when subtracting the \( \mathbf{j} \)-components, \( 6 - 2 = 4 \), leads to \( |-6\mathbf{i} + 4\mathbf{j}| = \sqrt{36 + 16} = \sqrt{52} = 2\sqrt{13} \). - Adding the absolute values of the components directly, \( |-6| + |8| = 14 \), confuses Euclidean distance with Manhattan distance.

body.en:
Problem (Easy): The variables \(x\) and \(y\) are related by the equation \(y = 2x^3 - 5x\). Given that \(x\) is increasing at a constant rate of \(3\text{ units per second}\), find the rate of change of \(y\) with respect to time at the instant when \(x = 2\).

Step-by-Step Solution: To find the rate of change of \(y\) with respect to time, apply the chain rule for connected rates of change: \[ \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x} \times \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t} \] 1. Differentiate \(y\) with respect to \(x\): \[ \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x} = \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}\left(2x^3 - 5x\right) = 6x^2 - 5 \] 2. Evaluate \(\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\) at \(x = 2\): \[ \left.\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right|_{x=2} = 6(2)^2 - 5 = 6(4) - 5 = 24 - 5 = 19 \] 3. Multiply by \(\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t} = 3\): \[ \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t} = 19 \times 3 = 57\text{ units per second} \] Common errors: - \(19\) corresponds to finding \(\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\) only and neglecting \(\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}\). - \(\frac{19}{3}\) corresponds to inverting the chain rule (dividing instead of multiplying by \(\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}\)). - \(21\) results from incorrectly differentiating \(2x^3\) as \(6x\) instead of \(6x^2\). Final Answer: \(57\text{ units per second}\).
body.ar:
مسألة تطبيقية (Easy): The variables \(x\) and \(y\) are related by the equation \(y = 2x^3 - 5x\). Given that \(x\) is increasing at a constant rate of \(3\text{ units per second}\), find the rate of change of \(y\) with respect to time at the instant when \(x = 2\).

الحل خطوة بخطوة: To find the rate of change of \(y\) with respect to time, apply the chain rule for connected rates of change: \[ \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x} \times \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t} \] 1. Differentiate \(y\) with respect to \(x\): \[ \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x} = \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}\left(2x^3 - 5x\right) = 6x^2 - 5 \] 2. Evaluate \(\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\) at \(x = 2\): \[ \left.\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\right|_{x=2} = 6(2)^2 - 5 = 6(4) - 5 = 24 - 5 = 19 \] 3. Multiply by \(\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t} = 3\): \[ \frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}t} = 19 \times 3 = 57\text{ units per second} \] Common errors: - \(19\) corresponds to finding \(\frac{\mathrm{d}y}{\mathrm{d}x}\) only and neglecting \(\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}\). - \(\frac{19}{3}\) corresponds to inverting the chain rule (dividing instead of multiplying by \(\frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}t}\)). - \(21\) results from incorrectly differentiating \(2x^3\) as \(6x\) instead of \(6x^2\). الناتج النهائي: \(57\text{ units per second}\).

label.en: Worked Example D — Vectors in Two Dimensions & Relative Motion (Easy Application)
label.ar: مثال محلول D — المتجهات في بعدين والسرعة النسبية (تطبيق Easy)

body.en:
Problem (Easy): Consider the cubic polynomial \( f(x) = x^3 - 5x^2 + 10x - 20 \). Find the remainder \( f(2) \) upon division by \( (x - 2) \).

Step-by-Step Solution: By the Remainder Theorem, \( f(2) = 2^3 - 5(2^2) + 10(2) - 20 = -12 \).

مسألة تطبيقية (Easy): Consider the cubic polynomial \( f(x) = x^3 - 5x^2 + 10x - 20 \). Find the remainder \( f(2) \) upon division by \( (x - 2) \).

الحل خطوة بخطوة: By the Remainder Theorem, \( f(2) = 2^3 - 5(2^2) + 10(2) - 20 = -12 \).

label.en: ⚠️ Common Exam Traps — Vectors in Two Dimensions & Relative Motion
label.ar: ⚠️ أخطاء شائعة في الاختبار — المتجهات في بعدين والسرعة النسبية

body.en:
1. Non-Commutativity of Matrix Multiplication & Cross Products: On Cambridge IGCSE Additional Mathematics (0606), assuming \(AB = BA\) (so expanding \((A+B)^2\) as \(A^2 + 2AB + B^2\) instead of \(A^2 + AB + BA + B^2\)) or forgetting \(\mathbf{u}\times\mathbf{v} = -(\mathbf{v}\times\mathbf{u})\) invalidates matrix proofs.

2. Using Position Vectors Instead of Direction Vectors for Angles: To find the angle at vertex \(B\) of triangle \(ABC\), you must use tail-to-tail vectors \(\overrightarrow{BA}\) and \(\overrightarrow{BC}\), never \(\overrightarrow{AB}\cdot\overrightarrow{BC}\) (which finds the exterior supplementary angle \(180^\circ - B\)).
body.ar: 1. عدم إبدالية ضرب المصفوفات: حاصل الضرب \(AB\) لا يساوي \(BA\) عموماً، وعند حساب الزاوية عند الرأس \(B\) يجب استخدام المتجهين المنطلقين من \(B\) وهما \(\overrightarrow{BA}\) و \(\overrightarrow{BC}\).

label.en: Worked Example E — Vectors in Two Dimensions & Relative Motion (Easy Application)
label.ar: مثال محلول E — المتجهات في بعدين والسرعة النسبية (تطبيق Easy)

body.en:
Problem (Easy): In \( \triangle ABC \), sides of lengths \( 32 \) and \( 10 \) meet at an included angle of \( 60^\circ \) opposite side \( x \). Find the squared length \( f = x^2 \) by the Law of Cosines.

Step-by-Step Solution: By the Law of Cosines, \( x^2 = 32^2 + 10^2 - 2(32)(10)\cos(60^\circ) = 804 \).

الحل خطوة بخطوة: By the Law of Cosines, \( x^2 = 32^2 + 10^2 - 2(32)(10)\cos(60^\circ) = 804 \).

question.en: [Practice 1 · Easy] The diagram shows part of the curve \( y = 6x - x^2 \), which intersects the \( x \)-axis at \( (0, 0) \) and \( (6, 0) \). Find the area of the region enclosed between the curve and the \( x \)-axis.
question.ar: [تدريب 1 · Easy] The diagram shows part of the curve \( y = 6x - x^2 \), which intersects the \( x \)-axis at \( (0, 0) \) and \( (6, 0) \). Find the area of the region enclosed between the curve and the \( x \)-axis.

hints.en: Tier 1 (Conceptual Setup): Identify the governing relationship in Vectors in Two Dimensions & Relative Motion and start from \( y = 6x - x^2 \).
hints.ar: تلميح 1 (الإعداد المفاهيمي): حدّد القانون الأساسي المرتبط بهذا السؤال وابدأ من المقدار \( y = 6x - x^2 \).

hints.en: Tier 2 (Key Transformation): Apply the key algebraic/geometric step leading toward \( x \).
hints.ar: تلميح 2 (خطوة التحويل الأساسية): طبّق التحويل الجبري أو الهندسي للوصول إلى العلاقة \( x \).

hints.en: Tier 3 (Final Verification): Check signs, units, and domain restrictions on your result before opening the full solution below.
hints.ar: تلميح 3 (التحقق النهائي): راجع الإشارات وقيود المجال في الناتج النهائي قبل إظهار الحل الكامل أدناه.

solution.en:
To find the area enclosed between the curve and the \( x \)-axis, integrate \( y \) with respect to \( x \) from \( x = 0 \) to \( x = 6 \):

\[
\text{Area} = \int_{0}^{6} (6x - x^2) \, \mathrm{d}x
\]

Integrate term by term:

\[
\int (6x - x^2) \, \mathrm{d}x = \left[ \frac{6x^2}{2} - \frac{x^3}{3} \right]_{0}^{6} = \left[ 3x^2 - \frac{x^3}{3} \right]_{0}^{6}
\]

Substitute the limits:

\[
\left( 3(6)^2 - \frac{6^3}{3} \right) - 0 = 3(36) - \frac{216}{3} = 108 - 72 = 36
\]

Common errors:
- Estimating the region as a triangle with base \( 6 \) and maximum height \( 9 \) yields \( \frac{1}{2} \times 6 \times 9 = 27 \).
- Taking the bounding rectangle gives \( 6 \times 9 = 54 \).
- Integrating \( 6x \) as \( 6x^2 \) without dividing by \( 2 \) gives \( 216 - 72 = 144 \), or subtracting \( 108 - 36 = 72 \).
solution.ar:
To find the area enclosed between the curve and the \( x \)-axis, integrate \( y \) with respect to \( x \) from \( x = 0 \) to \( x = 6 \):

\[
\text{Area} = \int_{0}^{6} (6x - x^2) \, \mathrm{d}x
\]

Integrate term by term:

\[
\int (6x - x^2) \, \mathrm{d}x = \left[ \frac{6x^2}{2} - \frac{x^3}{3} \right]_{0}^{6} = \left[ 3x^2 - \frac{x^3}{3} \right]_{0}^{6}
\]

Substitute the limits:

\[
\left( 3(6)^2 - \frac{6^3}{3} \right) - 0 = 3(36) - \frac{216}{3} = 108 - 72 = 36
\]

Common errors:
- Estimating the region as a triangle with base \( 6 \) and maximum height \( 9 \) yields \( \frac{1}{2} \times 6 \times 9 = 27 \).
- Taking the bounding rectangle gives \( 6 \times 9 = 54 \).
- Integrating \( 6x \) as \( 6x^2 \) without dividing by \( 2 \) gives \( 216 - 72 = 144 \), or subtracting \( 108 - 36 = 72 \).

hints.en: Tier 1 (Conceptual Setup): Identify the governing relationship in Vectors in Two Dimensions & Relative Motion and start from \( \log_2(5x + 6) - \log_2(x) = 3 \).
hints.ar: تلميح 1 (الإعداد المفاهيمي): حدّد القانون الأساسي المرتبط بهذا السؤال وابدأ من المقدار \( \log_2(5x + 6) - \log_2(x) = 3 \).

hints.en: Tier 2 (Key Transformation): Apply the key algebraic/geometric step leading toward \( \log_a(A) - \log_a(B) = \log_a\left(\frac{A}{B}\right) \).
hints.ar: تلميح 2 (خطوة التحويل الأساسية): طبّق التحويل الجبري أو الهندسي للوصول إلى العلاقة \( \log_a(A) - \log_a(B) = \log_a\left(\frac{A}{B}\right) \).

hints.en: Tier 3 (Final Verification): Check signs, units, and domain restrictions on your result before opening the full solution below.
hints.ar: تلميح 3 (التحقق النهائي): راجع الإشارات وقيود المجال في الناتج النهائي قبل إظهار الحل الكامل أدناه.

solution.en:
1. Apply the logarithm quotient law \( \log_a(A) - \log_a(B) = \log_a\left(\frac{A}{B}\right) \):
\[ \log_2\left(\frac{5x + 6}{x}\right) = 3 \]

2. Convert the equation from logarithmic to exponential form:
\[ \frac{5x + 6}{x} = 2^3 = 8 \]

3. Multiply through by \( x \) (noting \( x > 0 \)):
\[ 5x + 6 = 8x \implies 3x = 6 \implies x = 2 \]

4. Checking the domain:
Both \( 5(2) + 6 = 16 > 0 \) and \( 2 > 0 \), so \( x = 2 \) is a valid solution.

Common misconceptions:
- Calculating \( 2^3 = 6 \) instead of \( 8 \) yields \( 5x + 6 = 6x \implies x = 6 \).
- Incorrectly subtracting the arguments directly as \( \log_2((5x+6) - x) = 3 \) leads to \( 4x + 6 = 8 \implies x = \frac{1}{2} \).
- Forgetting to exponentiate the base and equating \( \frac{5x+6}{x} = 3 \) yields \( x = -3 \), which also violates the logarithm domain.
solution.ar:
1. Apply the logarithm quotient law \( \log_a(A) - \log_a(B) = \log_a\left(\frac{A}{B}\right) \):
\[ \log_2\left(\frac{5x + 6}{x}\right) = 3 \]

2. Convert the equation from logarithmic to exponential form:
\[ \frac{5x + 6}{x} = 2^3 = 8 \]

3. Multiply through by \( x \) (noting \( x > 0 \)):
\[ 5x + 6 = 8x \implies 3x = 6 \implies x = 2 \]

4. Checking the domain:
Both \( 5(2) + 6 = 16 > 0 \) and \( 2 > 0 \), so \( x = 2 \) is a valid solution.

Common misconceptions:
- Calculating \( 2^3 = 6 \) instead of \( 8 \) yields \( 5x + 6 = 6x \implies x = 6 \).
- Incorrectly subtracting the arguments directly as \( \log_2((5x+6) - x) = 3 \) leads to \( 4x + 6 = 8 \implies x = \frac{1}{2} \).
- Forgetting to exponentiate the base and equating \( \frac{5x+6}{x} = 3 \) yields \( x = -3 \), which also violates the logarithm domain.

question.en: [Practice 3 · Easy] Find the value of the integer \( n \ge 3 \) that satisfies the equation \[ {}^{n}\mathrm{P}_{3} = 10 \times {}^{n}\mathrm{C}_{2} \]
question.ar: [تدريب 3 · Easy] Find the value of the integer \( n \ge 3 \) that satisfies the equation \[ {}^{n}\mathrm{P}_{3} = 10 \times {}^{n}\mathrm{C}_{2} \]

hints.en: Tier 1 (Conceptual Setup): Identify the governing relationship in Vectors in Two Dimensions & Relative Motion and start from \( n \ge 3 \).
hints.ar: تلميح 1 (الإعداد المفاهيمي): حدّد القانون الأساسي المرتبط بهذا السؤال وابدأ من المقدار \( n \ge 3 \).

hints.en: Tier 2 (Key Transformation): Apply the key algebraic/geometric step leading toward \( {}^{n}\mathrm{P}_{3} = \frac{n!}{(n - 3)!} = n(n - 1)(n - 2) \).
hints.ar: تلميح 2 (خطوة التحويل الأساسية): طبّق التحويل الجبري أو الهندسي للوصول إلى العلاقة \( {}^{n}\mathrm{P}_{3} = \frac{n!}{(n - 3)!} = n(n - 1)(n - 2) \).

hints.en: Tier 3 (Final Verification): Check signs, units, and domain restrictions on your result before opening the full solution below.
hints.ar: تلميح 3 (التحقق النهائي): راجع الإشارات وقيود المجال في الناتج النهائي قبل إظهار الحل الكامل أدناه.

solution.en: Using the algebraic definitions of permutations and combinations: \[ {}^{n}\mathrm{P}_{3} = \frac{n!}{(n - 3)!} = n(n - 1)(n - 2) \] \[ {}^{n}\mathrm{C}_{2} = \frac{n!}{2!(n - 2)!} = \frac{n(n - 1)}{2} \] Substitute these into the given equation: \[ n(n - 1)(n - 2) = 10 \times \frac{n(n - 1)}{2} \] \[ n(n - 1)(n - 2) = 5n(n - 1) \] Since \( n \ge 3 \), we have \( n(n - 1) \ne 0 \). Dividing both sides by \( n(n - 1) \) gives: \[ n - 2 = 5 \implies n = 7 \] Common misconceptions: - Forgetting the \( 2! \) denominator in \( {}^{n}\mathrm{C}_{2} \) (treating it as \( {}^{n}\mathrm{P}_{2} \)) gives \( n - 2 = 10 \implies n = 12 \). - Dividing by \( n(n - 1) \) and erroneously writing \( n = 5 \) instead of \( n - 2 = 5 \) gives \( n = 5 \). - Confusing the factorial simplification to set \( n - 3 = 5 \) leads to \( n = 8 \). Answer: \( n = 7 \).

Dividing both sides by \( n(n - 1) \) gives: \[ n - 2 = 5 \implies n = 7 \] Common misconceptions: - Forgetting the \( 2! \) denominator in \( {}^{n}\mathrm{C}_{2} \) (treating it as \( {}^{n}\mathrm{P}_{2} \)) gives \( n - 2 = 10 \implies n = 12 \). - Dividing by \( n(n - 1) \) and erroneously writing \( n = 5 \) instead of \( n - 2 = 5 \) gives \( n = 5 \). - Confusing the factorial simplification to set \( n - 3 = 5 \) leads to \( n = 8 \). الإجابة: \( n = 7 \).
